bio.text: David Kustoff was first elected to the U.S. House of Representatives in 2016 and is serving his fifth term for Tennessee's 8th District.
He was born and raised in Shelby County, and earned his undergraduate and law degrees from the University of Memphis, graduating from law school in 1992.
President George W. Bush appointed him U.S. Attorney for the Western District of Tennessee in 2006, and in 2015 Gov. Bill Haslam appointed him to the Tennessee Higher Education Commission.
